sub_tasks.requirements: A behavioral test verifies that with the ReaLB pipeline enabled the end-to-end MMoE-layer wall time is not longer than a sequential (no-stream-overlap) reference by more than the scheduling+quantization cost, empirically confirming that transformation latency is hidden from the critical path as claimed in Section 4.3.

verification.spec: Run one MMoE layer forward under two configurations: (1) ReaLB-seq (no stream overlap), (2) ReaLB (overlapping pipeline). Time both over 100 iterations using CUDA events. Assert that the ReaLB wall time is less than ReaLB-seq wall time and within 5% of the pure MoE-compute time (excluding scheduling+quantization), confirming overhead is hidden.
